profile: Verastem is a biopharmaceutical company that develops and commercializes medicines for cancers driven by RAS/MAPK pathways. It markets AVMAPKI FAKZYNJA CO-PACK in the United States for adults with KRAS-mutated recurrent low-grade serous ovarian cancer after prior systemic therapy. Its pipeline includes clinical-stage and preclinical drug programs, including treatments under evaluation for other cancers.
